scope: retrospective cross-farm development; not prospective 2021 deployment; no Hill of Towie access
sampler: TPESampler(seed=2024), installed defaults, independent study per model
search_failure: OOM or nonfinite numerical failure consumes a trial, no replacement; other errors abort
selection: Kelmarsh 2021 validation MAE; exact ties earlier trial; no successful trial aborts
existing_configuration: TSMixer v32/P2 default 2 blocks, ff32, dropout .1, MAE .8/MSE .2; transformers A2 selected upstream use_norm=false; all other training settings v32
short_recipe: only max_epochs=10, patience=3; cosine T_max remains v32 20; epoch0 selectable
freeze: tuning_freeze after 180 attempted trials; all 60 formal trained records, inputs and source hashes verified before exclusive evaluation marker
ensemble: arithmetic mean of five prediction arrays, then compute original-scale MAE/RMSE/R2
accept: TSMixer tuned ensemble MAE <= .98*existing ensemble MAE and RMSE <= existing ensemble RMSE in BOTH folds
otherwise: retain existing configuration; seed-ensemble versus seed2024 is descriptive, not a replacement confirmation
